_comment: Pronunciation lexicon, applied to narration BEFORE synthesis.
Versioned like a prompt: the filename carries the version and the version
enters the TTS closure hash, so changing an entry re-synthesises exactly
the scenes that contain the term and nothing else.
Substitution is whole-word and case-insensitive, applied longest-first so
a multi-word entry wins over its own prefix.
Every entry needs a reason. A lexicon nobody can audit becomes a place
